label: Completing the square
subgoals: Read the centre from the coefficients

visual.title: Completing the square recovers the radius
visual.caption: Starting from x² + y² − 4x + 2y − 4 = 0, complete the square in x and y. The equation becomes (x − 2)² + (y + 1)² = 9, so the centre is (2, −1) and the radius is 3.

predict.question: Complete the square for x² + y² − 4x + 2y − 4 = 0. What is the radius?
predict.explain: Move the constant to get x² − 4x + y² + 2y = 4. Add 4 and 1 to both sides, giving (x − 2)² + (y + 1)² = 9. The right side is r², so r = 3.
